title: ZLIB/Deflate after signing
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 7. Step 6 — Compress; HCERT Specification, 4.2.1 Payload (CWT) Compression. QR Code Generation, 7. Step 6 — Compress: “Compression comes after signing, so the verifier decompresses before it verifies.”.

statements.label: ZLIB/Deflate after signing
statements.requirement: The issuer SHALL compress the COSE_Sign1 bytes with ZLIB (RFC 1950) using Deflate (RFC 1951) after signing. The verifier SHALL decompress before parsing COSE.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-ZIP-001 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-ZIP-001 what is compressed is the signed COSE_Sign1, as a ZLIB stream` (CompressTest.kt)).
